description: Fondazione IPRES publishes puglia electricity production, consumption and renewable facilities, 2020–2021. Provincial electricity information includes the 2020 energy balance and consumer categories, 2021 renewable facilities and photovoltaic facilities, and an overall production/consumption workbook for 2020–2021. TERNA is the underlying source. The native distribution titles explicitly establish electricity, while the short package title only says energy. Generation capacity units and plant-level identities are not established. Coverage is the Puglia region of Italy. The native catalogue provides CSV and spreadsheet distributions, with some linked visualisations. These alternative representations remain one resource; file contents and data rows were not inspected. The native licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a stated version. The national metadata mirror specifies version 4.0; the native statement remains unversioned. Metadata access is public, while file-use charges and restrictions are not established. Completeness and numerical accuracy are unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related national and regional catalogue representations are treated as the same publication only where their exact source identities match.
